description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the AbstractDocumentifier component within the SuiteCRM search module. It contains tests for methods `sanitizePhone` and `fixPhone`, verifying phone number sanitization and normalization functionality.

classes.name: AbstractDocumentifierTest
classes.description: This is a PHPUnit test class that extends SearchTestAbstract and tests the AbstractDocumentifier class's methods related to phone number processing.

methods.name: testSanitizePhone
methods.description: Tests the `sanitizePhone` method for proper cleaning and formatting of various phone number inputs.

methods.name: testFixPhone
methods.description: Tests the `fixPhone` method for normalizing phone numbers within a document array.
